scope: Two directly evaluated energy-cell midpoints at the peak-temperature shell; this is a targeted diagnostic, not global P1-B acceptance.
interpretation: At the peak-temperature shell, the first two energy intervals show 14.2% and 15.1% midpoint interpolation errors despite local quadrature changes below 0.031%. This isolates energy interpolation resolution, not quadrature order, as the dominant issue at these sampled points.
acceptance: Not passed; only two of four energy intervals at one radius were completed before the execution time limit. No full-star emissivity or optical-depth calculation is included.
